text:
jaya: Quick heads-up — we quietly crossed $2M ARR this month. Not a PR thing right now, but huge props to everyone. Want to do a tiny celebration this Friday? low-key. :sparkles:
marta: OMG amazing!! :tada: Suggestion: rooftop mini-sundae bar + a limited-run enamel pin drop. Pins as a tiny collectible for the office and sticker packs for remote.
ren: Can we have pin designs A/B poll? options: rocket, ramen bowl, potted fern, tiny server rack (nerdy). :rocket::ramen::seedling::computer:
theo: Server-rack pin is peak eng culture. we should absolutely lean into nerdy. also shout-out to infra for the graceful rollout yesterday. @eng-sre crushed it. :muscle:
anika: Love the rooftop idea but maybe keep volume low? also +1 for sticker packs for remote folks and a slack background pack.
design-bot: Uploaded 4 mockups: https://assets.internal/pins/3419901122/mockups.zip (pngs + print spec)
jaya: Nice. Let's run two small polls: 1) pin design, 2) in-office treat. I'll ask HR to run them.
hr-bot: Polls created: Pin pick — Rocket | Ramen | Plant | Rack. Treat pick — Mini-sundae | Mini-dumplings | Cold-pressed juice | Surprise box. Ends 24h. RSVP reminder will go out tomorrow.
marta: Tiny logistics: if you want a physical pin and you're remote, choose "sticker pack" in RSVP and we'll mail pins on a first-come basis.
ren: Also, tiny non-work celebration idea: 5-min "micro-kudos" circle at noon, where 3 people call out one person each for a quick shout. optional.
theo: I'll DJ a low-key playlist (instrumental). dropping a sign-up for a 10-min slot for photos/setting up.
anika: If we do pins, can someone volunteer to tape a little label with '2M CLUB' on the back? I will glue.
jaya: Shout-out to @theo and @ren for late-night fixes, and to product for the last-minute client tweak. mini kudos party for you all. :confetti_ball: (reacted :heart: by marta)
hr-bot: Reminder: RSVP by EOD Thu. Office capacity limits apply; remote sticker fulfillment will follow.
marta: Love this. Keeping it low-key and heartfelt. Thanks team — this is why we build. :hugging_face:
